title: Jeffrey Kripal's MIT lecture on flying saints, attended by a Skunk Works R&D head
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jeffrey Kripal's MIT lecture on flying saints, attended by a Skunk Works R&D head, about unspecified at MIT, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He was giving a lecture on flying saints at MIT.

related.note: Kripal speaking on levitation or flying saints to a Lockheed revolutionary-technology head. This is the same subject as the story of the levitation talk to Lockheed engineers, but here it is a public MIT lecture the head attended, not a private talk he asked for.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Jeffrey Kripal gave a lecture on flying saints, holy people said to levitate, at MIT, a university in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Michels says the head of revolutionary technologies at Skunk Works, the secret advanced aircraft division of the company Lockheed Martin, was in the audience, which would suggest serious engineers took an interest in stories of levitation.
